description: Tuesday afternoon the car started driving really heavy and jerky. It felt like it was pulling through mud even though the road was completely dry. Then a bunch of lights flashed on the screen behind the steering wheel and it wouldn't go very fast. It smelled kind of hot, like a toaster. I pulled over to the side of the road and after that, it just refused to drive forward. Nobody hit me and I didn't hit anything, it just decided it didn't want to work anymore.
